notes.title: 存档问题修复
notes.content: [p]Fixed an issue where you couldn't save mid-game[/p][p]I'm very sorry to see it nowːsteamsadː[/p][p][/p][p]First of all, thank you very much for being able to play this thing, and I played it with the difficulty of not having a mid-save, in fact, I was prepared to give you the SL mechanism of ESC and then continue the game, but today I discovered this abstract problem.[/p][p][/p][p]I am very aware of the abstraction of this platformer, especially the last two chapters are a bit inadequate, and suddenly realized that I don't seem to like the trend of the later development very much, and the development process is not well managed, which leads to a very negative attitude, and finally leads to the sloppy output of the second half.[/p][p][/p][p]The original plan was to let everyone see the changes in the original spikes and blocks, and the blocks that originally helped the player would not be so advantageous in the second half of the season, and the spikes grew into the fruits that helped the players grow.[/p][p][/p][p]But  LOOOOOOOL  it doesn't come true.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you to everyone who played.[/p][p][/p][p]I learned a lot, and I'll work hard next time.[/p]
